lines: Two-agent QA → Coder loop for a known bug
Add --autonomous to skip the acceptance gate (never commits)

card.summary: Two-agent QA → Coder loop for a known bug. Failing test first, smallest change to make it pass. Personas live in .claude/agents/.
card.paragraph: QA → Coder loop against one reproducible bug. Interview → render prompt → user acceptance → loop. The Coder cannot edit test files; touching them halts the loop.
use_when: You want failing test first, then minimal fix
dontuse_when: You don't have a repro yet

invocations.comment: Autonomous — skip acceptance gate; forces no-commit

extras.title: Halt conditions
items: Coder weakens or skips an assertion
Lint/build fails for an unrelated reason
--autonomous does not bypass any halt condition above — it only skips the acceptance gate and forces no-commit.
